title: Highly crystalline alpha-1, 3-glucan
abstract: Disclosed herein are compositions comprising insoluble α-glucan particles having a high degree of crystallinity and small particle size. For example, the alpha-glucan particles may have a degree of crystallinity of at least about 0.65, and/or an average size of less than one micron. At least 50% of the glycosidic linkages of the insoluble α-glucan in the particles of the present disclosure are α-1,3 glycosidic linkages. Methods of producing insoluble alpha-glucan particles are further disclosed, as well as their use in various applications and products.
